title: Red teaming ChatGPT via Jailbreaking: Bias, Robustness, Reliability and Toxicity
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to 'diagnosing AI ethics' and red-teaming ChatGPT. It uses benchmarks specifically designed to measure social bias (BBQ and BOLD), and BBQ includes categories evaluating bias against different religions. The authors explicitly structure their analysis around ethical hazards and the development of 'responsible' LLMs.
